snippet.description:
Unlock the mysteries of the human brain! Discover the secrets of Savant syndrome, creativity, and the power of right vs. left brain in this captivating exploration.

Journey through astonishing stories of savants like Stephon Wilshire—the “human camera” who sketches cityscapes from memory—and musical prodigy Matt Savage, whose jazz genius emerged after a pivotal breakthrough. See how cutting-edge neuroimaging uncovers the intricate interplay of our brain’s hemispheres, revealing why some individuals can perform seemingly impossible feats in art, music, and mathematics. Leading neuroscientists explain how left-brain injuries can unleash dormant right-brain abilities, transforming lives and challenging our understanding of genius.

Delve into the science of altered states of consciousness, from meditation in India to compassion studies in neuroscience labs. Learn how practices like mindfulness, meditation, and even spiritual experiences reshape our brains, boost creativity, and foster empathy. Experts like Dr. Jill Bolte Taylor and Dr. Darold Treffert reveal how balancing both hemispheres could unlock humanity’s potential, integrating logic with intuition, and science with spirituality.

Are we truly in the infancy of understanding the mind? See how bridging Western science and Eastern wisdom could drive the next leap in human evolution. From real-life Rain Man Kim Peek to the possibilities uncovered at Europe’s most advanced neuroimaging center, this video offers a hopeful vision of the future, where anyone might access extraordinary faculties hidden within.

snippet.title: War Factories: S03 EP01
snippet.description:
Discover the untold story of how Rolls-Royce and the Merlin engine turned the tide of World War II. Modern wars aren’t won by battles—they’re won by factories.

Dive deep into the incredible journey of wartime production, where innovation and mass manufacturing determined victory. Uncover how icons like Porsche, Skoda, and especially Rolls-Royce evolved through wartime necessity, shaping both the Spitfire and Hurricane—legendary fighters of the skies. Learn how Rolls-Royce’s meticulous engineering philosophy, starting from the Silver Ghost to the groundbreaking Merlin engine, revolutionized aviation and powered legendary planes like the Mosquito, Lancaster Bomber, and the P-51 Mustang. 

Explore the human stories of visionaries like Henry Royce, Charles Rolls, Mutt Summers, and Tilly Shilling, whose inventions and decisions changed the course of history. Understand how the move from handcrafted engines to mass production, including collaboration with Packard in America, proved crucial as the Allies raced to out-produce the Axis powers. Discover dramatic moments from the Battle of Britain, trans-Atlantic flights, the bombing war, and how the Merlin engine allowed Allied bombers and fighters to dominate the skies.

From royal staff cars to armored desert vehicles used by Lawrence of Arabia, from a Silver Ghost’s endurance run to cutting-edge aviation engines, this documentary reveals how Rolls-Royce became a symbol of both luxury and technological supremacy. Whether you’re fascinated by WWII, engineering, or legendary brands, this is the ultimate tale of competition, innovation, and industrial triumph.

snippet.title: Guadeloupe: An Island Living in Fear | Free Documentary
snippet.description:
Guadeloupe: An Island Living in Fear | Free Documentary

Surviving Diepsloot - South Africa’s No-Go Zone: https://youtu.be/t0zkJjfZPGs

A dire economic situation and a strengthening drug trade places the capital of Guadeloupe in the top spot for homicides, robberies and violence against children - for all of France, as it’s a French overseas department and region.  A sad statistic which the police, local organisations and volunteers are working to change. 

Having faced eighteen armed robberies of her small store, a shopkeeper in Pointe-à-Pitre is hesitant to even share her own experiences of violence. In the city centre, shop owners grit their teeth: insecurity and danger is becoming ever more commonplace. The film hears from an intellectual figure on the island, Édouard Boulogne, who explains the root of the problems that are shaking up Guadeloupe.

This documentary was first released in 2014. In 2026, the crime situation in Guadeloupe remains a significant concern compared to 2014, with persistent challenges in violent crime and organized activity, though it continues to be categorized as a relatively low-risk destination for most travelers. While historical 2014 data showed the territory already struggling with high homicide rates relative to mainland France, 2026 reports highlight continued issues with drug-related violence and prison overcrowding.

snippet.title: Inside America's Most Extreme Prison for Children
snippet.description:
For many troubled teenagers, there is no middle ground between a broken home and a prison cell. In this sobering look inside the juvenile justice system, we follow Carlton, a repeat offender facing his harshest sentence yet: a transfer to the Department of Corrections' notorious "Boy School." From the anxiety of the early morning transport to the stark reality of the intake strip-search, we see firsthand what happens when the streets catch up to kids as young as twelve. Alongside Paradize, a 15-year-old girl who cut off her ankle monitor to escape her family struggles, these raw human stories reveal the tragic pipeline from childhood trauma to maximum security confinement—and the desperate struggle to find a way out before "The Big House" claims them forever.
